name: Low-Poly Silhouette First
description: Block out the readable outline of an asset using as few polygons as possible before adding any surface detail.
when_to_use: Any character, prop, or environment piece that must be recognisable at gameplay distance.
conceptual_steps: Establish silhouette in 50-300 polys against a solid background.
Verify recognisability at 64 px height (gameplay scale).
Only after the silhouette reads correctly, add bevels, panels, and surface-level detail.
Bake high-poly detail into normal maps where polycount budgets are tight.
tradeoffs: Iteration speed vs visual fidelity. Block-out cost is low; refactoring a fully-detailed mesh is expensive.
